title: api.request.v1
description: Phase 9 — emitted by the API gateway on every inbound request, before the response is written. Carries request identification and timing of the security and auth gates. Per §8.16.9 dual-emit doctrine, when a Phase 7 quarantine fires for the same request, the matching sec.alert.v1 carries event_correlation_id = request_id.

request_id.description: Unique id for this request, minted at gateway ingress. Rounds-trips through api.response.v1 and predict.cancel.v1.

user_id.description: Authenticated user id. Absent for anonymous/public requests.

anon_subject_key.description: Rate-limit subject key (masked IP or user id hash). Never raw IP — see §7.6 SubjectKey contract.

route.description: OpenAPI route pattern (e.g. /v1/matches/:id), NEVER the substituted path.

status_anticipated.description: Expected response status if known at emit time (e.g. early 429 from rate-limiter); null when unknown.

accepted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the gateway accepted the connection.

sec_gate_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds spent in the Phase 7 security gate (denylist + rate-limit check). Absent when gate was skipped.

auth_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds spent in JWT verification + session lookup. Absent for unauthenticated routes.
